title: A line of an Omaspec trace, version 1
description: One JSON object a line (JSON Lines): what one object of a running system did. `omaspec trace` holds the lines, in order, against the state machines of a project. A field that is null counts as absent; other fields are left alone. See docs/trace.md.

object.description: Who did it: goes by the state machine named like it, or by the one `machine` names. Many objects may share one machine.

event.description: The event the object took, as the machine writes it, without its guard or action.

state.description: The state the object is in afterwards, by the name transitions use. On an object's first line without an event: where it begins.

machine.description: The state machine the object goes by, where the object is called otherwise.

time.description: When, as the system writes it; findings name it.
